positions.name: MissingIdDeriveBehavior
positions.frame: what must id-derivation guarantee when the input reproduces the missing-id failure pattern seen in prod?
positions.why: src-1 sets up the exact failure condition being reproduced (no id field, ## heading level) as witnessed from prod; src-2 and src-3 are the two directives that state what correct behavior must hold under that condition (no crash, valid slug produced). Read together, the assertive framing of the reproduced case and the directive requirements cohere as one statement about what this test case demands — the assertion names the trigger, the directives name the guarantee.
